# Ntfyx for DeepSeek Harness
中文 · Ntfyx · Install the CLI
Send task notifications and rich reports from DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) to your phone. Ask a question
, answer with buttons or text on iPhone, Android or a phone-authorized Web Inbox, and let the local
Ntfyx CLI verify and claim the reply before the agent continues.
**Plugin 0.1.0 · Ntfyx CLI 0.6.0+ · DSH 0.2.2-alpha.2 · Node.js 24.9+.** DSH is in developer preview
; this initial release declares only the DSH version it was checked against.
## Install
Install the signed Ntfyx CLI without configuring another agent:

`connect` is needed for protected notifications and phone questions. Scan and authorize the connecti
on from Ntfyx 1.8.0+ and select a protected Topic. Public Topic operations require no pairing.
Install the native bundle in the DSH profile you use:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Replace `web` with your profile name. If you launch DSH through npx, use `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2
-alpha.2` in place of `dsh`. DSH's plugin command also requires pnpm on PATH. Restart an already run
ning profile after installation.
GitHub is an alternative package source; the bundle ships ready to use and has no build or installat
alternative package source; the bundle ships ready to use and has no build or installation scripts:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Tell DSH:
> Read the ntfyx skill, then use Ntfyx to ask me a test question on my phone. Use Ntfyx for decision
s and send a completion notification for this task.
An actual signed reply returning to the waiting agent verifies the phone workflow. A successful inst
allation alone does not verify phone delivery.
### Discover in the DSH interface
If you enable DSH's experimental **Custom plugin indexes** bundle, open **Plugins → Discover → Add i
ndex source** and add:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
This is the Ntfyx-maintained index. It shows the native bundle with its icon, English/Chinese detail
s and install confirmation; it does not make the plugin a DeepSeek-maintained Official bundle.
## What the bundle provides
The native `cordis.patch.yml` starts your installed `ntfyx mcp` through DSH's official MCP client an
d registers the bundled `ntfyx` skill. The package includes English and Chinese plugin details and a
n icon for DSH's Plugins page. It contains no credentials, transcript uploader, hosted MCP endpoint
or replacement approval engine.
| Capability | DSH tool |

| Protected notifications and rich reports | `mcp__ntfyx__ntfyx_send` |
| Phone questions | `mcp__nt

fyx__ntfyx_ask` |
| Wait for and claim a verified answer | `mcp__ntfyx__ntfyx_result` |
| Cancel a p

ending question | `mcp__ntfyx__ntfyx_cancel` |
| Local rich-message validation | `mcp__ntfyx__ntfyx_

validate_message` |
| Public Topic notifications and reads | `mcp__ntfyx__ntfyx_public_send`, `mcp__

ntfyx__ntfyx_public_read` |
| Paired Inbox usage | `mcp__ntfyx__ntfyx_usage` |
Use one `session_id` for the current task's updates and questions. Pending questions keep the same `
request_id`; continue only after `status: "answered"` and `consumption.claim_acquired: true`. For a
confirmation, only `response.value: "allow"` permits the described action. Denial, timeout, cancella
tion and failed verification never mean consent. Existing authorization and the user's channel choic
rification never mean consent. Existing authorization and the user's channel choice remain in force.
Completion notifications are agent tool calls. This version has no automatic lifecycle hooks, does n
ot intercept native DSH questions, and does not approve DSH tool-permission prompts. DSH's normal pe
rmission policy still controls tool execution.
## Update or remove
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart the profile. Removing the bundle preserves your Ntfyx CLI and paired credentials.
For a GitHub installation, install the new release tag with `add github:KaylaONeal/dsh-plugin-ntfyx#
vNEW_VERSION`; updating a pinned tag does not select a newer tag.
## Verify locally
From a checkout of this repository, with Node 24+ and npm installed:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The test installs a small set of official DSH runtime packages with install scripts disabled, packs
this bundle, and boots its real patch in an isolated profile. It checks Ntfyx MCP discovery, local m
essage validation and installed skill discovery. It uses an unpaired temporary identity store, calls
no model, and sends no notification. Evidence is saved under `.local/dsh-plugin-test/`. Use `--runt
ime PATH` to reuse a runtime created by an earlier run.
## Troubleshooting
Run `ntfyx doctor` and `ntfyx version --json` in the environment that launches DSH. Desktop launcher
s must also have `ntfyx` on PATH. The bundle's MCP entry ID is `ntfyx-mcp`; its transport timeout al
lows a 45-second Ntfyx question/result wait. If the CLI is absent or cannot start, DSH logs an MCP c
onnection error and continues; fix PATH and restart. Avoid adding a second MCP client named `ntfyx`
d continues; fix PATH and restart. Avoid adding a second MCP client named `ntfyx` in the same scope.
DSH's `--dump-config` can inspect composition without starting plugins:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
[该节后续省略]
## Distribution and privacy
This is the Ntfyx-maintained community plugin for DSH. DeepSeek currently distributes its own Offici
al bundles and ships no default third-party plugin index. The upstream contribution guide recommends
publishing a GitHub repository with the `dsh-plugin` topic and currently does not accept external p
ull requests. See the official contribution guide and plugin-index guide.
Protected messages and answers are encrypted on devices; the service handles routing metadata and ci
phertext. Public Topic messages are visible to the service and anyone who knows the Topic ID, are no
t end-to-end encrypted, and cannot authorize actions. The user must explicitly accept the public-con
tent terms before the first public send; a Topic link is not consent.
The bundle configuration and skill are MIT licensed. The companion CLI, apps and hosted service foll
ow their own license and service terms. This repository does not contain Ntfyx's application core or
a self-hosting distribution. Privacy · Support.
